stories.title: GPT‑6 Cyber: Advancing the frontier of aligned cybersecurity agents
stories.explanation: OpenAI introduced GPT-6 Cyber, a cybersecurity model trained to find and fix exploitable vulnerabilities while staying within authorized scope. It shows significant improvements over GPT-5.6 Cyber on benchmarks like ExploitGym and is already securing real-world software.

stories.title: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash: Fast and cost-effective with longer clips
stories.explanation: Google rolled out Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash, which offers native 15-second video creation, improved reference adherence, and multi-turn conversational editing. This update also lowers costs by 30% and is generally available across the Gemini API and Gemini for business.

stories.title: Setting a new standard for responsible AI infrastructure
stories.explanation: OpenAI introduced its National Community Compact and Compute Campus Policy Blueprint to guide responsible AI infrastructure development. These initiatives aim to protect local resources, create jobs, and ensure communities have a say in the development of AI computing campuses.

stories.title: Meta says US users can now video chat with their Muse AI avatar
stories.explanation: Meta announced that US users can now video chat with their Muse AI agent, which features customizable animated avatars powered by Muse Realtime Avatar and Muse Realtime Voice technology. This aims to make interactions with the AI agent more engaging and personalized for consumers.

stories.title: Vera Delivers the Best of Both Worlds: Highest Throughput and Fastest Agents
stories.explanation: NVIDIA Vera delivers high throughput and fast agent performance per watt within a single CPU, providing one CPU for a range of AI agent workloads. This helps AI factories support more agents quickly and efficiently within power limits.

stories.title: New NVIDIA Cosmos 3 Open Models for Interactive World Simulation
stories.explanation: NVIDIA Cosmos world model development platform released four new open-weight checkpoints for its Cosmos 3 model family, designed for interactive world simulation and multi-sensor multi-view driving scenes. These models have 16B parameters and are available for commercial and non-commercial use.

stories.title: More Performance From Every Byte: How Full-Stack Codesign Solves AI’s Memory Challenge
stories.explanation: NVIDIA uses full-stack codesign, integrating GPUs, CPUs, networking, storage, and software, to optimize memory usage in AI factories. This approach aims to get more useful work out of memory at every layer of the AI factory, addressing increasing GPU memory pressure.

stories.title: Big Tech claims voters’ AI backlash is “anti-Trump” not “anti-tech”
stories.explanation: Voters in recent US elections overwhelmingly supported measures and candidates to restrict AI and data centers, with 38 out of 44 data center initiatives passing. This indicates a significant public pushback against the AI industry's expansion.

stories.title: A Closer Look at Phonon TTS. Launching High-Quality On-Device Speech That Tops the Benchmarks.
stories.explanation: Hugging Face launched Phonon TTS, a small text-to-speech model that runs on-device without a server or network, ensuring privacy and offline functionality. The model's weights are open, with Phonon 31m available under Apache 2.0 for commercial and non-commercial use.

stories.title: Claude can now analyze your spending with its new Personal Finance tool
stories.explanation: Anthropic's Claude now includes a 'Personal Finance' tool, allowing users to connect bank accounts via Plaid to analyze spending. This positions Claude as a financial companion, catching up to similar tools offered by OpenAI's ChatGPT.
